page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head above the text. Heads and paragraphs in the column, no margin notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: giæ & virtutis,non autem essentię, dicunt Simo-niani.
Spiritum sanctū esse fororem Christi, Hel-cesaitæ [?].
Spiritum sanctum se esse dixit Manes siue Manichæus.
Spiritum sanctum se & suum scortum appel-lauit Simon Magus, Montanus.
Spiritum sanctum esse creaturam, non autem Deum, Origenistæ, Arriani, Acatiani, Macedo-niani, Aetiani, Feri.
Spiritus sancti partes & essentiam, ipsam per omnes creaturas esse diffusam; Macedoniani, Seruetani.
Spiritum sanctum negant esse datum Apostolis quantum satis est, Cataphryges; Montanistæ, Manichæi.
main_text.head: Credo Ecclesiam sanctam.
De prædestinatione quæ fundamen-tum est Ecclesiæ.
main_text.p: Prædestinationem ullam esse negant Pelagia-ni, Celestiani.
Prædestinationem & electionē non Dei gratiæ, sed nostris operibus tribuunt Basilidiani, Caiani, Pelagiani, Papistæ.
Prædestinationē astris & fato tribuunt Bar-desanistæ, Priscillianistæ.
Prædestinatione ad sceleta quælibet perpe-tranda abutuntur Prædestinati dicti, Libertini.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "cesaitæ" in the Helcesaitæ entry is hard to read and marked [?]. The first word of the page, "giæ", is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The catchword "N" is at the lower right. Printed spelling kept, including "Celestiani", "Seruetani", "Pelagiani" and "essentię". No page number is printed on this page.
